note:
R7 — bounded parse of the PS4 Attrib/VLT collection registry (`gccollections.vlt` + `gccollections.bin`,
`gcschema.vlt` + `gcschema.bin`) on NHL 15–21, and the DB-id -> collection -> asset-path chain test.

Read-only. Reads the already-extracted `databigs/Extracted/nhl/data/common/database/attrib/` trees of the seven
PS4 installs and the committed anchors (`anchors/ps4/<title>/databases/nhl_game.db`; NHL 20 from the real install
member, as in ps4_team_field_map.py).

Format (verified on NHL 21 first, then checked title by title — see the JSON `container` block per title):
  .vlt  = chunk chain `tag(4, FourCC stored reversed) | size(4, incl. header) | payload`:
          Vers, StrN, DepN (names the sibling .bin), DatN (collection records, 8-aligned, tiling the payload),
          ExpN (count u32, then 16-byte rows key|tag|size|absoluteVltOffset), PtrN (12-byte fixups
          slotOffset|type(u16)|flags(u16)|targetOffset, in two segments: (0,2,1,0) then slots inside the .bin,
          (0,2,0,0) then slots inside the .vlt; every target is a .bin offset; (0,0,0,0) ends), EndC.
  .bin  = StrE (NUL-separated string pool) | TofC (count u32, then (classKey, collectionKey) u32 pairs in ExpN order)
          | EndC | unframed heap of instance blobs / RefSpecs / vectors that the fixups point at.
  record (vlt) = collectionKey u32 | classKey u32 | u32 0 | u32 nInline | u32 1 | u32 nInline | u16 nTypes | u16 |
          u32 0 | ptr(8) -> instance blob in .bin (attributes laid out per the schema class) | nTypes type keys |
          zero pad | nInline entries of 24 B: attrKey u32 | 0 | value/ptr (8) | typeIndex u16 | flags u16 | 0.
  keys  = Bob Jenkins lookup2 (1996) with initval 0xABCDEF00 over the name bytes — verified for class names, type
          names and attribute names; collection keys are NOT this hash of the DebugName (opaque here).
Schema class record (48 B): classKey | u32 | attrCount | ... | ptr@16 -> attrCount x 16-byte descriptors
          attrKey u32 | typeKey u32 | offset u16 | size u16 | count u16 | flags u8 | code u8 ; instance size @40 (u16).

Usage: python vlt_collections.py <out.json> [--titles nhl21,nhl15,...]
